scope: 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12, standard 2–4-player multiplayer including required two-player Rival, optional standard CHOAM; no solo, Rival variants, six-player teams or cross-game expansions. Relevant official FAQ January 13 2025 clarifications included.

questions.question: How is the Conflict deck built, and what happens to unused Conflict cards?
What are the starting score, Agents, troops and water for a human in a four-player game versus a three-player game?
Can you Reveal with Agents left, and can you later take an Agent turn in the same round? What cards supply Reveal effects and where do all played cards go?
May an Agent-turn card effect provide resources to pay the destination entry cost? How many Agents can one card send, and can a card without Agent icons be used?
At a Combat space you recruit three troops this turn and already have four garrisoned. How many can deploy? What if the destination is not a Combat space, and where do recruited troops originate?
How do you use a Spy Agent icon, Infiltrate and Gather Intelligence? Can the same Spy pay for both, and when must Gather Intelligence be chosen?
With two troops, one sandworm and four revealed swords, what is your strength? What if your final unit is removed? Can you participate in Combat Intrigue with no unit?
If you pass Combat Intrigue and an opponent then plays one, may you act again? When does the window close, and where do troops and sandworms go after rewards?
Compare two players tied for first in a four-player Conflict with the same tie in a three-player Conflict. Who takes the Conflict card, and can a zero-strength player get a reward?
What does a sandworm do to rewards: do two sandworms quadruple them, can control or battle icons double, and how is a reward offering 3 spice for 1 VP handled?
When is a normal battle-icon match checked, which cards qualify, is matching optional, and how is a wild icon used?
What are the rewards and reversibility at 2 and 4 Faction Influence, and does tying the Alliance holder at 4 steal the Alliance?
When can Persuasion be spent during Reveal, may it be pooled or split, can you buy a Row replacement immediately, and where does the acquired card go?
How do Maker bonus spice, the Shield Wall and Maker Hooks affect harvesting and summoning, and where can a sandworm be placed?
At what point does 10 VP or an empty Conflict deck end play, what happens before comparing final VP, and what are the rulebook resource tiebreakers?

With optional standard CHOAM, how many contracts start face up and face down, which extra cards are added, is Shaddam compulsory, and are the 10 contrasting-back contracts part of this standard setup?
Under CHOAM, what does the contract icon do, what if all contracts are taken, and how are Harvest, Immediate and Acquire The Spice Must Flow contracts completed?
You gain a board-space contract after already sending your Agent to that space this turn. Can you complete it now? Once completed what do you announce, gain and do with the token?
In standard two-player play how many Rivals are used, who gets the Ornithopter Objective, who gets First Player, what is the turn order, and does a Rival Reveal?
A Rival reveals an occupied board space, then a Place Spy card. How does it proceed, which space costs and effects apply, and what happens when House Hagal is empty or Reshuffle is drawn?
How are eligible Objective cards selected and distributed in standard three- or four-player setup, how is First Player chosen, and may Shaddam be chosen without CHOAM?
If the bank runs out of Solari, spice, water or sandworms, what happens? Contrast an empty personal troop supply, and state where resource payments go.
State all five round phases in order, when Conflict and hand cards are drawn, and what Recall does if Endgame is not triggered.
May you resolve board-space effects, Agent-box effects and Faction Influence in any order? Can you use that visit’s Influence to meet its entry requirement?
Can an optional arrow cost be paid twice in an Agent turn? Which effects are normally optional or mandatory, including costs on Intrigue cards?
Where may a new Spy be placed, what if all your Spies are already deployed, and what if its placement effect specifies an Agent-icon type?
Can you Infiltrate your own occupied board space, use a Spy without playing a card, or recall two connected Spies to Gather Intelligence twice on one placement?
Who gets control bonuses when visiting Arrakeen, Spice Refinery or Imperial Basin, how is control transferred, and where does the defensive troop originate?
When two players tie for second in a three-player Conflict, what happens? What if players tie for third in four-player play, or three players tie for first?
At a normal three-player Conflict with three different positive strengths, which places receive rewards? What if a two-player game’s Rival is one of the participants?
When can Plot, Combat and Endgame Intrigues be played, how are unplayed Intrigues kept and ordinary ones discarded, and what if the Intrigue deck is exhausted?
Can you discard an Intrigue for an ordinary discard instruction? Where does an ordinary discard come from? How does Secrets choose which Intrigue is stolen?
Which cards may a trash effect remove, where do ordinary and Reserve cards go, and is trashing optional? Does trashing The Spice Must Flow remove its acquired VP?
When do acquire-box effects resolve, when do you reshuffle your deck, and can unused Persuasion be carried to another round?
What counts as in play for Fremen Bond, can two Bond cards activate one another regardless of play order, and when do they cease being in play?
Can Recall Agent return the Agent placed this turn, and when can the recalled Agent act again? Where does a retreated troop go, and may “retreat any number” mean zero?
When an effect grants two Influence with a freely chosen Faction, may it be split? What is required for an Alliance-icon effect or a minimum-Influence effect?
If an Alliance holder loses Influence after being tied with two opponents, who receives the token? If the holder drops to 3 and no one has 4, what happens?
What happens to a card drawn during Reveal compared with one drawn after Reveal? What happens to a Plot Intrigue played earlier whose effect applies at Reveal?
May a “when you win a Conflict” Intrigue be played after tying for first? What if you receive such an Intrigue as a reward for an outright win?
What if final VP, spice, Solari, water and garrison troops all remain tied, and may scores exceed 12?
Can you delay completion of two held contracts for the same board space after visiting, and when in the Agent turn can their effects resolve?
Under CHOAM does Shaddam begin with his set-aside Sardaukar contracts, when can he take one, and how long does his Signet Ring deployment restriction last?
For Feyd, where does the Training token start and what happens at its last space? Which Jessica side begins face up and can Reverend Mother Jessica act on the flip turn?

For Margot and Irulan does moving from 1 to 3 Influence count as reaching 2, can it trigger again later, and does descending through 2 count? Does Clean Up trigger Spacing Guild’s Favor discard ability?
State Accept Contract and Dutiful Service’s Agent icons and effects with and without CHOAM, and whether both automatically advance a Faction track.
What do Arrakeen, Fremkit and Research Station each cost and provide, what Agent icons access them, and which are Combat spaces?
Compare Deep Desert and Hagga Basin’s entry costs, base spice and worm choices. Do you still collect bonus spice when choosing worms, and are Hooks spent?
For each Sietch Tabr option, state requirements and effects. Do you get a troop when choosing to remove the Shield Wall?
How do High Council’s first and subsequent visits differ, what does each cost, when is its ongoing benefit used, and is it a Combat space?
What does Swordmaster cost before and after anyone obtains one, how often may each player visit, and when can the new Agent be used? Does a Rival obtaining it lower human cost?
State Imperial Privilege’s Agent icon, requirement, entry cost and effects. Which Agent can it recall and does it automatically give Emperor Influence?
State Shipping’s access icon, Influence requirement, cost and gains. Does its free-choice Influence have to be with the Guild?
Compare Gather Support and Spice Refinery’s zero-cost and paid options and Combat status.
State Heighliner, Desert Tactics and Sardaukar’s entry costs, Influence gains, recruits and other effects; which allow normal deployment?
What are Assembly Hall, Espionage and Deliver Supplies’s Agent icons, costs and effects, including Assembly Hall’s timing condition?
What must False Orders’ affected opponents do, may it be played without an opposing Spy connected to your destination, and when is Litany Against Fear’s red box ignored?
With Manipulate, may opponents acquire the removed card, may you acquire it by other means with the discount, and when does an unacquired card leave the game?
What components and resource does the standard two-player Rival start with, what happens to the 2P Reshuffle card, and can its 10 VP trigger Endgame and victory?
When does a Rival buy Swordmaster, how does it count and prioritize spending resources, does it keep leftovers, and is its Agent available immediately?
After a Rival has Swordmaster, which exact resource sets does it spend for VP, and can it spend a mixed total of seven resources for a VP?
When choosing Influence, how does a Rival select the Faction and break ties? Does it get VP at 2 and Alliance VP, or the track bonus at 4? What does a numbered Hagal Influence icon mean?
A Rival reveals a two-destination Hagal card and the condition-selected destination is occupied. Can it use the other destination, and what conditions select these cards?
A Rival has no troops newly recruited by a card sending it to Combat. Can it deploy garrison troops? What if a Hagal card recruits at a noncombat space or has a conditional 2-Influence bonus not met?
How does a Rival choose an unrestricted Spy post, what happens if all Faction posts are occupied, and what occurs on placing its third Spy? Can it Infiltrate or Gather Intelligence?
If a Rival’s Scheme recruits troops before a Hagal Agent reaches a Combat space on that same turn, what happens to those troops? What if a Place Spy card found no legal post?
At Hagga Basin or Deep Desert, how does a Rival choose worms versus base spice with Hooks, without Hooks, or with a protected Conflict? What happens to accumulated bonus spice?
When and how is a Rival’s Combat strength bonus determined, what if Reshuffle appears, and can humans respond afterward? Does a unit-free Rival get this bonus?
Can a Rival gain control, defensive troops, battle-icon VP and doubled rewards? How does it handle optional Conflict VP payments and contract rewards with CHOAM?
When during Reveal do you total, announce and set Combat strength, can you update it during the turn, and how is strength over 20 marked?
When is a Leader’s Signet Ring ability activated, does merely revealing Signet Ring activate it, and can card text override normal game rules?
How is a Recall Spy icon on a card resolved, where does the Spy go, and is it automatically the same as Infiltrate or Gather Intelligence?
What does the “trash an Intrigue” icon allow you to choose, as opposed to an ordinary discard-a-card instruction?
A Conflict reward grants one Influence of your choice and is doubled by your sandworm. May the two gains go to different Factions? Contrast a single effect that grants two Influence.
A House Hagal card shows a Signet Ring effect for the two-player Rival. Which ability is resolved, and does the Rival need a human Signet Ring card or a Reveal turn to trigger it?
For a two-player Rival, what do House Hagal Maker Hooks and Shield Wall removal icons do if it already has Hooks, lacks Hooks, or the wall is already gone?
For Secrets, state its Agent icon, entry cost, Combat status and all effects, including which Intrigues come from the deck and which come from opponents.
For Imperial Basin, state its Agent icon, entry cost and Combat status, how much base and bonus spice the visiting player receives, and what its controller receives if that same player controls it.

At Round Start, where is the newly revealed Conflict placed, what happens to any unclaimed Conflict card left from earlier rounds, and does each player draw the round’s five cards before or after revealing the Conflict?
At standard human setup, where do the four Faction Influence cubes and Alliance tokens begin, does anyone start with an Alliance, and is the Shield Wall initially present?

In a normal three- or four-player round, who takes the first Player Turn, how does turn order proceed after someone Reveals, and exactly when does Player Turns end? During Combat Intrigue, who has first priority, in which direction does priority proceed, and how many Combat Intrigues may an eligible player play before yielding?
What are the three steps of a Reveal turn, in order? Must the Reveal-box effects be resolved in card order, or may the player choose their order?

Before the first round without CHOAM, how are each human starter deck, Intrigue deck, Imperium deck/Row and Reserve stacks prepared? Where do the human Combat marker, three Spies, Councilor and Control markers start?
Which cards may you ordinarily acquire with Persuasion, where is each acquisition cost shown, and during which kind of your turn may you make those ordinary Persuasion purchases?

When a human receives a Spy placement icon or a Recall Spy icon, may the player decline the action even if a legal Spy/post exists? Does a Shield Wall destruction icon require destruction, and if destroyed can the Wall return in a later round?

For an ordinary Agent turn, what must match between the played card and destination? You have a Spy connected to Shipping, but your played card has only a City Agent icon. Does the connected Spy itself let that card send an Agent to Shipping? What changes if the card actually has the Spy Agent icon?

You lack the resource for a destination’s entry cost. May you first play and resolve a Plot Intrigue during that Agent turn to obtain it, then pay entry and send the Agent? Contrast trying to use resources from the card played to send that Agent, or from the destination itself, to pay that same entry cost.

In standard two-player play, both humans take early Reveal turns while the Rival still has an Agent in its supply. Does Player Turns end immediately? What happens to the remaining Rival Agent turns, and does the Rival ever take a Reveal turn before Combat begins?
For all 22 standard board spaces, give a compact reference table listing the Agent access icon and whether it is a Combat space (yes or no). Use the standard 2–4-player board.
